title: pretty LILYANA|Plus Size Chiffon Pleated A-Line Back Cutout Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Get ready to turn heads in this stunning Plus Size Chiffon Pleated A-Line Back Cutout Bridesmaid Dress! The chiffon material is soft and lightweight, making it a breeze to wear. The pleated details bring an element of sophistication, while the A-line silhouette flatters all body types. The back cutout adds a modern and chic twist, ensuring you stand out from the crowd. A must-have dress for any plus size bridesmaid looking to make a statement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
